item.title: We Won a Bookish Super Bowl Bet + Parade Snaps
item.description: Like all of the Emerald City, The Seattle Public Library has been reveling in the Seahawks’ Super Bowl win — but in a very library-like way. Late last week, we placed a bookish bet with Boston Public Library: The library with the winning team would get to create a booklist for the other to host. […]
